Variants.Content: A castle's kitchen is both the source of feasting and the shadow of power. A nobleman sees his master's pomp from the dishes, a cook sees waste and famine from the heat and leftovers, and a servant knows that the most dangerous gossip often occurs when the fire is the brightest and everyone thinks no one is paying attentionhour.

Entry Kitchens and Hearths A castle's kitchen is both the source of feasting and the shadow of power. A nobleman sees his master's pomp from the dishes, a cook sees waste and famine from the heat and leftovers, and a servant knows that the most dangerous gossip often occurs when the fire is the brightest and everyone thinks no one is paying attention.
